_about: Testimonials for Patrick McKowen. 'site_quote' is the short pull-quote shown in the Praise section of patrickmckowen.com, with 'site_highlight' as the phrase set in bold/white there (null if not captured). 'linkedin_full' is the full recommendation text from LinkedIn (captured 2026-11-22), or null if the person has no LinkedIn recommendation. Use site_quote for cards and linkedin_full when you need a longer quote or a different excerpt.

testimonials.name: Jason Culbertson
testimonials.featured_note: Also used as the single featured testimonial between Gallery and About on the homepage: 'Patrick helped elevate the work of everyone around him.' / VP of Design, Cameo
testimonials.site_quote: Patrick helped elevate the work of everyone around him. His thoughtful approach to design and exceptional communication skills made complex projects feel simple.
testimonials.site_highlight: Patrick helped elevate the work of everyone around him.
testimonials.linkedin_full:
Working with Patrick was one of the highlights of my time at Cameo. His thoughtful approach to design and exceptional communication skills made complex projects feel simple. Patrick's contributions, particularly in developing the Cameo Design System and leading design for Cameo for Business, were critical to both the company and the design team. He has a knack for detailed, clear documentation and a deep understanding of user needs, making him an invaluable contributor to the product organization.

Patrick also helped elevate the work of everyone around him. He provided mentorship to others as well as support to his cross-functional peers while balancing perfection with practicality under tight deadlines. I wholeheartedly recommend Patrick for any organization looking to improve their design capabilities and team.

testimonials.name: Prajit Gopal
testimonials.current_title_linkedin: Product @ Adobe GenStudio | CS Masters @ UPenn | Forbes U30
testimonials.site_quote: Patrick's deep commitment to understanding our customers led to some of our most valuable insights, and his collaborative spirit makes him a joy to work with.
testimonials.site_highlight: his collaborative spirit makes him a joy to work with.
testimonials.linkedin_full:
I had the pleasure of working with Patrick at Cameo for Business, where his exceptional skills as product designer were an invaluable asset to our product team. As Head of Product, I was very lucky to have Patrick as a partner for all of our product discovery work. Patrick's deep commitment to understanding our customers and stakeholders was evident in his diligent efforts to regularly review market research, customer interviews, and any other resources he could get his hands on. His keen analysis frequently led to some of our most valuable and actionable insights.

Patrick has a meticulous attention to detail, both in writing requirements and in executing designs. He has an ability to maintain precision while understanding the necessity of trade-offs to meet deadlines. Beyond his professional capabilities, Patrick's collaborative spirit makes him a joy to work with.

Patrick’s blend of rigorous analysis, attention to detail, and team-oriented approach truly sets him apart. I wholeheartedly recommend Patrick to any organization looking to take their design team to the next level.

testimonials.site_highlight: Patrick’s ability to connect the dots across multiple projects
testimonials.linkedin_full:
I had the pleasure of managing Patrick at JDRF, where his commitment to innovation and results-driven design consistently elevated our digital tools. Patrick is not just a product designer; he is a strategic thinker, a collaborative team leader, and a reliable source of knowledge in UI/UX. His passion and innovative approach to user experience, coupled with his ability to understand and align with business goals, make him a standout in the field.

Patrick's contributions went far beyond design; he was instrumental in marrying business strategy with UI/UX best practices, thereby developing supporter experiences that surpassed many of our peers. He was also pivotal in designing a user-centric information architecture, significantly improving our digital ecosystem's usability and effectiveness.

As a manager, witnessing his ability to connect across multiple projects and deliver thoughtful, impactful results was truly inspiring. His dedication and talent in creating a collaborative environment, and his knack for constantly pushing the boundaries of digital product design, make him an invaluable asset to any team.

testimonials.name: Prescott Rynewicz
testimonials.site_quote: Patrick is unnaturally good at asking first-principle questions to ensure his team are on the right path. He is an incredible designer, a diligent student of product development, and a wonderful human being.
testimonials.site_highlight: Patrick is unnaturally good at asking first-principle questions
testimonials.linkedin_full:
Patrick is an incredible designer, a diligent student of product development, and a wonderful human being. Building the Cameo for Business platform from the ground up with Patrick was a joy. From early user interviews and problem framing to pixel-perfect QA, Patrick was the best design partner an engineering leader could ask for.

Patrick is deeply passionate about the experiences he designs but can easily detach his ego from his work to make clear and thoughtful decisions when presented with qualitative data. Patrick is unnaturally good at asking first-principle questions to ensure he and his team are on the right path. When needed, Patrick can be a perfectionist and will nerd out on design craft, but knows how to let go of low-impact tradeoffs that users will never notice.

testimonials.current_title_linkedin: human-centered content designer @ metamask | previously linktree, cameo
testimonials.relationship: Worked on the same team (early-career UX writer mentored by Patrick)
testimonials.site_quote: Patrick is a skilled designer who asks thoughtful questions, leads with grace, and always has valuable critique to offer. He chases excellence in all that he does and makes everyone around him better.
testimonials.linkedin_full:
Working with Patrick at Cameo was such a gift. He is a skilled designer who asks thoughtful questions, leads with grace, and always has valuable critique to offer. He chases excellence in all that he does and makes everyone around him a better designer.

On top of all of that, he’s generous in his mentorship of more junior teammates. I joined the Product Design team at Cameo as an early career UX Writer. Patrick took an hour every week to discuss design thinking, share UX best practices, and provide feedback on my work. I’m so grateful I got the chance to be on his team.
